summary: Iter 52 — Batch feature regression for the 4 new features (Entertainment portal, POS email+SMS receipts, super-admin SMS points crediting, admin-configurable late-fines). BACKEND: 7/7 pytest PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter52_batch_features.py). Verified: (1) GET/PUT /api/settings/late-fines round-trip persistence (grace_minutes/fine_5/fine_10/fine_15/fine_30) and auth guard returns 403 for anonymous. (2) POST /api/super-admin/tenants/{tid}/sms-points as super-admin credits N points and returns new balance {ok:true, sms_points:int}; salon-admin call correctly forbidden (403). (3) POST /api/invoices with customer (email=delivered@resend.dev, phone=+91...) returns receipts.email.sent=true (Resend delivered) AND receipts.sms.sent=false with error='not_configured' — verified tenant sms_points is UNCHANGED (point refunded correctly by _send_billing_receipts). (4) POST /api/invoices for customer WITHOUT email returns receipts.email.error='no_email'. (5) GET /api/reports/morning-briefing/audio returns valid text; when IST hour < 12 the text mentions Bhakti/Entertainment (asserted conditionally). FRONTEND (Playwright, 1920×4000): (a) Sidebar nav-entertainment present. (b) Dashboard MorningBriefing card shows mira-bhakti-suggestion + mira-play-bhakti-btn linking to /entertainment?play=bhakti&timer=30 — clicking navigates to Entertainment page, YT iframe (yt-player) loads and timer-countdown shows '29:59'. (c) Entertainment page: all 4 channel-* cards (bhakti/chill/hits/party) render, clicking channel-chill starts yt-player, source-spotify toggle switches to spotify-player iframe (external spotify iframe throws its own client-side exception unrelated to our code), source-youtube switches back, timer-30 sets 29:59 countdown, pause-btn hides player and reveals play-btn. (d) Settings → attendance-fines-card renders with all 6 test-ids (fine-grace-minutes, fine-5/10/15/30-input, fines-save-btn); editing grace=9, fine_5=77, fine_30=333 and saving persists across full page reload. (e) Super-admin: sms-points-{tenantId} button visible with balance badge showing '37' — clicking opens window.prompt (captured), submitting '50' via dialog.accept succeeds and badge updates to '87' (exactly +50, matching backend behaviour). (f) POS UI loads and services can be added; checkout blocked in the script because guest was not fully selected (test-script limitation, not a bug — invoice + receipts flow is already covered by pytest).

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — a select/option element in POS.jsx has a <span> inside its <option>. Causes React error #418 in production build. Non-blocking but should be fixed.

Spotify embed iframe emits its own client-side exception ('RangeError: Incorrect locale information provided' inside embed-cdn.spotifycdn.com). This is inside the 3rd-party Spotify iframe, not our code, so it's non-blocking — but the embed may occasionally render an error state to the user for certain playlists/locales. Consider passing locale=en explicitly or catching visibility for a graceful fallback.

action_items: (Low, code hygiene) Fix POS.jsx hydration warning — the inside
(Optional) Pass explicit locale param to Spotify embed URL to prevent 'Incorrect locale information' RangeError inside the 3rd-party iframe.
critical_code_review_comments: _send_billing_receipts (server.py L2806-2836) is correctly transactional for SMS points: decrements 1 pt only after a $gte:1 gate, then refunds via $inc:+1 if send fails. Confirmed via test: baseline pts unchanged after failed Twilio send. Good.
credit_sms_points (L4941-4952) correctly uses $inc (not $set) and returns fresh balance via a follow-up find. Also logs to sms_credit_log with actor email + timestamp — good for audit. LGTM.
settings/late-fines (L1240-1248) trivial GET/PUT via Pydantic LateFineSettingsIn with Field bounds (ge=0, le=100000, plus grace ≤ 120). Auth guard require_tenant_admin verified. LGTM.

MorningBriefing.jsx (L197-205) mira-bhakti-suggestion is gated by local hour <19; renders Link to /entertainment?play=bhakti&timer=30. Entertainment.jsx parses ?play + ?timer from location.search on mount and auto-starts the channel + countdown — verified in playwright. Good UX.
Entertainment.jsx uses external YouTube + Spotify embed URLs — no CSP issues encountered. yt-player key changes on channel switch so iframe fully reloads (avoids stale player state). Good.
SuperAdmin.jsx creditSms (L165-176) uses window.prompt — works but not ideal for accessibility / mobile. Consider a proper shadcn Dialog with number input in a future polish pass.
server.py still ~6178 lines (still growing) — split-out flagged in iter50/51 remains outstanding.
